prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone Kalistar character illustration, portrait 4:5 (ideally 1122 x 1402), edge-to-edge artwork. Absolutely no card frame, words, letters, logos, numbers, stats or UI. Match the supplied Momo and Valazar references: narrative hand-painted fantasy illustration, constructed colour planes, expressive believable anatomy, selective visible oil/gouache brushwork, lost-and-found edges, worn tactile materials, motivated light. Paint the face with colour planes too; no photographic pores, glossy CGI, manga/anime eyes, airbrushed beauty advertising, artificial depth-of-field blur or uniformly applied texture noise. Face and principal action readable in the central 60 percent width, important objects clear of the outer 10 percent, enough breathing room for a later 737 x 921 card illustration crop. The painting is a narrative instant, not a character posing for a camera.
Reference roles: image 1 is the EXACT Kaylis identity reference: preserve her recognizable face, warm medium-brown skin, South Asian/Indian and Afro-Caribbean mixed heritage, age 23, her dark eyes and existing curling vine-like prismatic tattoos on both arms. Images 2 and 3 are Momo and Valazar, STYLE ONLY; do not import their characters or setting.
New scene: Kaylis training alone in the stone exercise ground raised and shaped by Balmhyr behind his Canyonero home. Balmhyr and all companions are ABSENT. A few solid, worn red-grey stone platforms and shoulder-height pillars make a clearly constructed practice course; distant simple red-grey canyon walls and clear blue sky, broad quiet background shapes, not a dense city, no ruins or floating debris storm.
She is slightly more muscular than the reference, a credible agile athlete, not a bodybuilder. Practical black braided hair tied back, a few small loose curls identify the same young woman. Clothing EXACTLY: black sleeveless turtleneck top, truly bare shoulders and upper arms so the tattoos remain visible, WHITE practical full-length trousers with real creases, black training shoes/boots. No sleeves, cape, skirt or black trousers. Existing rainbow tattoos emit a restrained, clearly separated spectrum along her arms with just a little light reflected onto her face and fabric.
The instant is a fluid fencing pivot: one boot grips the stone, the other foot is stepping through the turn, torso and shoulders actively counter-rotate, braids and trouser fabric follow the motion. A focused, breathless, confident half-smile: she is enjoying learning control, watching where her blade goes, not looking at the viewer. In one hand ONE elegant fencing foil/rapier: long slender perfectly straight steel blade, continuous from a small coherent guard to its tip; not a katana-shaped broad blade. The other arm balances her naturally, with one visible hand. Keep the whole single weapon, its hand-to-hilt connection and both shoes in frame. Human anatomy exactly one head, two arms, two hands, two legs; no motion-echo limbs or doubled blades. Three-quarter view of her whole body, her face recognizable rather than tiny, no severe perspective shortening of the sword, no fashion pose or exaggerated sexualized arch. Bright natural light, cool shadows, the effort and momentum make the scene emotionally alive.
